items.en: Ukraine Intercepts 55% of russia's Jet-Powered Shahed Drones as New Countermeasures Enter Combat
items.nl: Oekraïne onderschept 55% van Ruslands straalaangedreven Shahed-drones nu nieuwe tegenmaatregelen in gevecht worden ingezet
items.sEn: According to Defense Express, Russia launched more than 2,730 jet-powered Shahed-type drones against Ukraine in September alone. Ukrainian forces destroyed or suppressed more than 1,500 of them, an effectiveness of roughly 55%; that figure counts both drones that were physically shot down and those whose attacks were…

items.en: Ракета или дрон: в польской прессе оценили «Герань-5»
items.nl: Raket of drone: Poolse pers beoordeelt de 'Geran-5'
items.sEn: Voennoye Obozreniye (topwar.ru) relays an assessment by the Polish outlet Defence24 of Russia's jet-powered Geran-5, asking whether it is a drone or a cruise missile. items.en: Ukraine unveils SBU jet-powered interceptor drone and reports kills on jet-powered Geran drones; Russian jet drone crashes near Chisinau
items.nl: Oekraïne toont straalaangedreven interceptor-drone van de SBU en meldt neerhalingen van straalaangedreven Geran-drones; Russische jetdrone stort neer bij Chisinau
items.sEn: On 19 September 2026 President Zelensky announced that Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) has developed a new interceptor drone, already successfully deployed against jet-powered Shahed-type drones.
